source.title: Irish News, 3 June 1967, p. 1; Belfast News-Letter, 3 June 1967, p. 7 ("Rural council results: Ballyhoe")
source.publisher: Irish News (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Divisions, names and votes read from the Irish News of 2 June 1967, p. 1, and the Belfast Telegraph of the same date.

note: Triennial election, polled Thursday 1 June 1967. Two divisions were contested; the other divisions were filled unopposed and their names were not printed in the reports used here. Mulholland elected by 47 votes. The Telegraph printed the division as Ballyhoe and the figures 160 to 113. Division is Ballyhoe ('In the Ballyhoe division election, Mr. John P Mulholland polled 160 votes, 47 more than his opponent Mr. John McCollam', Irish News 3 Jun 1967 p. 1; 'for the Ballyhoe division', BNL 3 Jun 1967 p. 7); previously filed under the candidates' home, Loughgiel (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026).
